I deal with all security related issues publicly and transparently, and it can sometimes take a while before I
get a chance to address it. If this is an issue for you, you need to not use the tools in this repository. The
fastest way to get a bug fixed is to submit a pull request, but if this is impractical for you please post a
ticket to the public GitHub issue tracker.

If your ticket relates to a specific file, please attach the file directly to the ticket.
